quoted_text: Fiscal Year 2023 Highlights: Revenue of $1,058.6 million increased 19% year-over-year. ARR of $1,203.8 million increased 30% year-over-year. Gross margin was 83% for fiscal year 2023, compared to 81% in fiscal year 2022. ... Our ARR was $1,203.8 million and $925.3 million at January 31, 2023 and 2022, respectively, representing a growth rate of 30%. ... dollar-based net retention rate ... 123% and 145% as of January 31, 2023 and 2022, respectively. ... As of January 31, 2023, the aggregate amount of the transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was $894.0 million.
notes: FY2023 (year ended 2023-01-31) is the fiscal year UiPath's ARR growth rate and dollar-based net retention rate both cratered (retention 145%->123%, the sharpest decline in the company's public history) alongside a well-documented leadership crisis: the co-CEO structure (Ashim Gupta / Rob Enslin alongside founder Daniel Dines) was unwound in April 2023 when Dines resumed sole CEO duties, and the company announced workforce reductions in the same window. Sales & marketing expense (66.3% of revenue) exceeded even this repo's own SOFTWARE template's built-in Downside-scenario illustrative default (42%) -- a real, disclosed inefficiency more severe than the template author's own worst-case assumption.
